period: [from,to); explicit offsets and IANA timezone; backend computes consistent snapshot and watermark

metrics.definition: Distinct ticket IDs created within period in authorized scope; reopened ticket keeps one ID. Include cancelled tickets in volume, label cancellations separately in detailed dataset. Status/category breakdown must use the same cohort and snapshot.

100 * satisfied eligible SLA cycles / eligible SLA cycles due within period; approved pause intervals and reopened cycles follow pinned backend SLA policy. Cancelled/not-applicable cycles excluded with explicit counts. Empty denominator means missing, not 0 or 100.
Distinct backend assignment IDs accepted within period; offered/expired/rejected proposals excluded. Reassignment is another assignment ID and must be labelled in detailed dataset, not a new ticket.

Distinct work-order IDs whose evidence/completion backend verified within period; Supervisor completed alone excluded. Reopened work order is counted once per distinct ID in the cohort; expose reopened/cancelled breakdown separately.

notes: DD07 owns code computation and detailed breakdown schema; C14 owns authorized snapshot queries/persistence. This proposal does not register executable metrics or claim real backend support. Freeze meanings and pin versions before publish. Any incompatible denominator/cohort change must increment metric version.
